Principal engineer and project manager for the Github integrations and CI/CD pipelines.

## Context
Overseeing build failures, deployment issues, and permission management. Communicates primarily via email and manages permissions and permissions requests from GitHub.

- Handling permission requests
- Addressing build failures and deployment errors
